value.rationale: Sharp distances and all eccentricities of a named Platonic cubic graph are natural complete reconfiguration invariants not supplied by published connectivity; different labelled versus unlabelled palette diameters quantify a meaningful symmetry effect. This exact finite benchmark is a motivated complete object, not a renamed theorem, arbitrary parameter slice or tiny bound gain.
